'''Nesan 21 (November 16)'''
==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - [[Sedrin a'Conlin|Sedrin]], son of Lady [[Meri do Ahlan a'Conlin]] of [[Murandy]], is born near Tar Valon. Ellya, daughter of [[Careme Mowly]], is born near Tar Valon.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Egwene]] meets with [[Gawyn]]. [[Rand]] goes to [[Cairhien]] and meets the Tower delegation.
*{{ne|999}} - The [[Wise Ones]] meet with [[Sheriam]]'s group.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Theodrin]] gets [[Nynaeve]] drunk in an effort to break her block.
